_info: Post-session radio conversations. D = driver, RE = race engineer. Placeholders: {d} driver short name, {p} position, {e} engineer name. Each context has calm / normal / rage variants (add more lines to each list for variety).

calm: Good lap, the car felt balanced today. P{p}, nice.
Well done, {d}. We will keep the same setup for tomorrow.
normal: D
Decent session. I think there was a little more in the car, though.
RE
Copy that. We will check the data and find where you can gain it.
rage: D
P{p}?! I had the pole lap, the car snapped on the last corner!
RE
Understood, {d}. We will look into the rear stability. Great job anyway.

calm: P{p}. The car is okay, just lacking a bit of top speed.
Copy. We will look at the wing levels for the race.
normal: D
The balance is not quite there. Understeer into the slow corners.
RE
Ok, we will find it out and adjust for the race.
rage: D
This car has no grip! Every lap I am fighting it!
RE
Copy, {d}. Keep calm, we will find out what is going on.

calm: Tough session. We are missing pace everywhere.
Understood. We will go through the data tonight and fix it.
normal: D
P{p}... the car just won't turn. I can't carry any speed.
RE
Ok, we will find it out. Race pace is what matters now.
rage: D
What is this car?! It is undriveable! P{p} is a joke!
RE
Copy, {d}. I hear you. We will find the problem, I promise.

calm: Yes! What a car today, thank you everyone.
Brilliant drive, {d}. The strategy and the tyres were perfect.
normal: D
We did it. The car was really good in the final stint.
RE
Well done. P1, that is a race win.
rage: D
FINALLY! This is what the car should have been doing all season!
RE
Copy that, {d}. Enjoy it. Great race.

calm: P{p}, good result. The car felt strong on the tyres.
normal: D
Podium, nice. We were a bit short on pace at the end.
RE
Copy. We will check the data to find that last bit.
rage: D
P{p}? I could have won it if the car had more straight line speed!
RE
Understood, {d}. We will work on that. Good podium.

calm: P{p}. Solid points, the tyres held up well.
Good job, {d}. Points for the team.
normal: D
I was stuck in traffic the whole race. The car had no pace to pass.
RE
Ok, we will find it out. Thanks for the push.
rage: D
I could not overtake anyone! The car is slow on the straights!
RE
Copy, {d}. We will bring upgrades. Good points today.

calm: Tough race. The tyres just fell away at the end.
Understood. We will review the tyre data after the race.
normal: D
No pace today. The car was sliding everywhere.
RE
Ok, we will find it out. Let's reset for next weekend.
rage: D
P{p}?! This car is a disaster! I am wasting my time!
RE
Copy, {d}. We hear you. We will work on it, I promise.

calm: I have lost power. I have to stop the car.
Copy, {d}. Stop the car safely. We will check what happened.
normal: D
Something broke at the rear. The car just died.
RE
Ok, bring it into the pits. We will find out what happened.
rage: D
Not again! The car broke AGAIN! What are you doing back there?!
RE
Copy, {d}. I am sorry. We will investigate right away.

calm: That penalty hurt us. I thought I was within the limits.
Copy. We will look at the onboard and see what happened.
normal: D
Five seconds, that was harsh. The car was a handful in that corner.
RE
Ok, we will find out why the car slid there.
rage: D
That penalty is a joke! The car was undriveable out of that corner!
RE
Understood, {d}. We will check it and talk to the stewards.
